picks.question: Will inflation reach more than 4.5% in 2026?
picks.why: Inflation above 4.5% would signal renewed price pressure, complicating Fed rate decisions and eroding household real wages.

picks.question: Strait of Hormuz traffic returns to normal by December 31?
picks.why: About a fifth of global oil passes through Hormuz, so prolonged disruption keeps energy prices and shipping costs elevated worldwide.

picks.question: Billionaire one-time wealth tax passes in California election 2026?
picks.why: A state-level billionaire wealth tax would test capital flight, revenue estimates, and a policy idea long debated by economists.

picks.question: Will Anthropic have the best AI model at the end of December 2026?
picks.why: Which lab leads frontier AI shapes where investment, talent, and pricing power concentrate in a fast-growing industry.

picks.question: Will OpenAI not IPO by December 31, 2027?
picks.why: Whether OpenAI goes public by 2027 signals how much of today's private AI valuations public markets are willing to absorb.

picks.question: Will AI solve 0 more Millennium Prize Problems in 2026?
picks.why: An AI solving a Millennium Prize Problem would mark a leap in machine reasoning, with implications for research productivity.
